The depot was Southgate. I replied to Tobias in a thread on his message in #inc-tansley-carrier-api.

The answer comes from that channel, which Tobias is a member of. On 3 Sep 2025 Pree wrote that label printing had stalled at Tansley Parcel depots and that Southgate dispatch had totes stacked beside door 4. When she closed the incident at 18:43, she said Southgate had cleared the backlog. Southgate is the only depot the channel names, so I told Tobias to ask Pree if he needs the full list of affected depots or an address.

I left out material from Pree's private notes and from an email Tobias can't see. That included a September 2025 root-cause email to the customer about a different site, Tulsa, which also mentions a service credit. I also left out all pricing.
